verdict.rationale: Capsule documents a general bearer-token HTTPS API and UI-based pipeline stages, but nothing shows API endpoints for updating opportunity stages or next steps. There is no MCP server, no agent-driven updates from email or meeting signals, and probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt. A generic API is only a developer building block, so it earns no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent update deal stages and next steps from email and meeting signals via the API or MCP server
